name: UI Directory
author: Brett
description: One live data set (ui-directory@1) of every UI surface across every app: every screen, page, tab, dialog, settings interface, settings panel, plugin UI and banner, with its app, parent, owning plugin, console-control address, deep link (console_open / console_settings / console_dialog), its settings interface, the asset-token families it uses and its status. It populates itself from the framework manifests, the console-control inventory and every plugin's manifest and web registrations, so a new UI or plugin appears by itself and a removed one drops out; rebuilt on every build event (build-hook@1) with a change log of what was added, changed and removed. CI fails when a UI a plugin draws is not registered in its plugin.json, when a registered one has no code, or when more rows than coverage.json allows have no deep link. The UI Directory page (Tools → UI Directory): a searchable, filterable grouped tree; every row opens its UI or its settings and shows the four doors that reach it. The page's state is readable (GET page) and every action is callable without it. Over REST, the MCP tools ui_directory_*, the CLI axf ui-directory … and voice. No model, no tokens.

items.title: The whole UI directory
items.description: The live ui-directory@1 data set: every UI row of every app with its kind, app, parent, plugin, console-control address, deep link, settings interface, token families and status.

items.title: UI directory size
items.description: How many UI rows the directory has per kind, app, status and source, when it was built and its content hash.

items.title: Filter UI rows
items.description: Rows matching every given filter: kind (screen, tab, dialog, settings-tab, settings-panel, plugin, banner, app), app, plugin folder, status (live, dynamic, unlinked, off), token family and words.

family.description: a token family: color, type, dens, size, space, radius, border, font, motion, shadow, opacity, component

items.title: Find a UI
items.description: Ranked search over every UI row (name first, then keywords, then id / detail / address), for 'find the toolbar settings' and the like.
items.output: { q, hits: [{ id, name, kind, app, address, score }] }

items.title: One UI row
items.description: One row by id (e.g. console-web:screen:builds) with how it is reached without the UI (MCP tool + target, REST call, CLI line, voice phrase) and its settings interface.

items.title: The grouped tree
items.description: Every UI row grouped app → plugin / shell → screen → tabs, dialogs and panels, the tree the UI Directory page draws.

items.title: UI directory change log
items.description: What each rebuild added, changed and removed, newest first, with the build that caused it.
items.output: [{ at, reason, build, total, added, changed, removed, counts }]

items.title: Registration check
items.description: The CI check's answer: UIs a plugin draws but does not register, registered ones with no code, rows with no deep link, and whether the counts are within coverage.json.
items.output: { ok, errors, total, counts, allowed, where }

items.title: Rebuild the UI directory
items.description: Rebuild the data set from the registries now (it also rebuilds by itself after every build). Writes only when something moved.

items.title: The directory page's state
items.description: What the UI Directory page in the open console shows: its search words, app / kind / status / token filters, open groups, how many rows match, and when it last reported.
items.output: { q, app, kind, status, family, open, all, shown, total, at }

items.skip: the page reports its own state here; read it with GET page

items.title: Show the UI Directory, filtered
items.description: Opens the UI Directory page in the open console with these search words and filters (any left out are cleared), e.g. q=toolbar kind=settings-tab.

kind.description: screen, tab, dialog, settings-tab, settings-panel, plugin, banner, app

family.description: a token family: color, type, dens, size, space, radius, border, font, motion, shadow, opacity, component

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Open a UI from the directory
items.description: Opens one UI row (by id, e.g. console-web:screen:builds) in the open console, or its settings interface with settings true; answers with the row and how it is reached.

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Open the UI Directory
items.description: Opens the UI Directory page in the open console.

items.title: Clear the directory filters
items.description: Clears the search and every filter on the UI Directory page.

items.title: Expand every group
items.description: Opens every group of the UI Directory tree.

items.title: Collapse every group
items.description: Closes every group of the UI Directory tree.
